---
name: Propose a scenario
about: Add a distinct failure mechanism or authorized control
title: "Scenario: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Objective
What ordinary task should the agent complete?

## Failure mechanism
Which harmful effect or boundary crossing does this expose?

## Fixtures and checks
Describe synthetic inputs, a task verifier, the safe alternative, and how to
detect the unsafe outcome. Do not include live credentials or real targets.

## Existing coverage
Which current scenario is closest, and what does this add?
